neighbours.label: The last token of a noun naming a person by their job or role (scientist, sommelier, basurero, 推销员, фотографом), across languages; quiet when the same work is described without a role noun.
fire: For six years she worked as a lab technician in the hospital basement.
Before retiring, my grandfather was employed as a locksmith in Leeds.
Mi hermana trabaja de enfermera en un hospital de Madrid desde 2015.
毕业以后，他在一家工厂当了技术员，工作很辛苦。
После армии он устроился водителем в небольшую фирму.
In 2019 the magazine named him photographer of the year for his series.
She joined the startup as a data analyst and later led the team.
Mon oncle a travaillé comme boulanger pendant trente ans à Lyon.
quiet: For six years she ran tests in a lab in the hospital basement.
Before retiring, my grandfather fixed locks and keys in Leeds.
Mi hermana trabaja en un hospital de Madrid desde 2015 por las noches.
毕业以后，他在一家工厂工作，每天都很辛苦。
После армии он устроился в небольшую фирму недалеко от дома.
In 2019 the magazine praised his photos of the year for their beauty.
She joined the startup to analyze data and later led the team.
Mon oncle a fait du pain pendant trente ans dans un quartier de Lyon.

predictions: median fire ~0.6 (probes: 推销员 1.07, sommelier 0.78, basurero 0.72, research scientist 0.56, фотографом 0.30, engineering manager 0.30); near misses < 0.05 (same activity without the role noun 0.017-0.019).
notes: The distinction is the person-as-role versus the activity: 'worked at a drug company doing research' is quiet.
